method: The whole of ~/codewatch-research/gaps/misses.tsv (a header plus one row: CVE-2026-136182, cve-pairs-python-frontend, CWE-601). No Python or JavaScript cases in the file and nothing to skip. I read the fix commit's message and full per-file diff (gh api repos/HarnessRouter/harnessrouter/commits/7db36fd28c13a1362f1c734745f962f829a962ed) and the two changed source files at its parent d5ea34c (ui/src/app/login/page.tsx, ui/src/components/SelfHostLogin.tsx, raw via the contents API), which show both the request-side read and the redirect sink. The new test file and the new safe-next.ts were read as well to confirm what the fix refuses.

notes.source: ui/src/app/login/page.tsx:18-20 const next = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('next') || '' : ''; (the next query parameter of /login?next=..., read from the address bar in a Next.js client component; passed as a prop at :22 return <SelfHostLogin next={next} />)
notes.sink: ui/src/components/SelfHostLogin.tsx:30 window.location.assign(next || '/harnesses'); (client-side navigation after a successful password sign-in; next is used verbatim, so https://evil.example/ or //evil.example leaves the site)
notes.between: the value only crosses a React prop: LoginPage's next -> SelfHostLogin({ next }) -> the submit handler's window.location.assign. No check of any kind on the way, not even a startsWith('/'), and the second use in page.tsx passes the same raw string. The fix adds ui/src/lib/safe-next.ts and calls safeNext() at both read sites: it requires a single leading '/', refuses backslashes and %2f/%5c, resolves the value against a placeholder origin and keeps only a path whose origin is unchanged. A second explanation for the miss is source: the taint origin is window.location.search in browser code, not a server request object.
notes.fix: adds a safeNext() helper (site-relative path only, no backslash or encoded slash, origin rechecked against a placeholder) and applies it where the next parameter is read and before window.location.assign
